Core working hours are set from 09:00 to 15:00 on working days, effective 1 October 2026, as established by the board resolution of 15 September 2026[[cite:obs-6c430ea26b214a09bb41013dc744daa4d3520383 "Core hours are set from 09:00 to 15:00 on working days, effective 1 October 2026."]].
